correctness.rationale: For each finite level, the Pascal map is unit lower triangular over F2; therefore its transform of iid fair coefficient bits is independent fair scenery. Independent geometric holding times yield an iid regenerative decomposition, with almost-sure vanishing empirical scenery sum. Fubini yields the conditional bracket limit, and bounded-increment martingale FCLT yields quenched independence of Brownian coordinates. Exact covariance of scenery at two times is the probability of no negative step between them, giving the displayed variance. The iid block vector (G-2,Gf) has covariance diag(2,6) and mean cycle length 2, yielding an annealed functional limit diag(1,3) after a justified renewal time change. Current checker.py passed 302 exact assertions; no finite test was substituted for a limit theorem.

originality.rationale: The motivating paper proves only annealed Brownian convergence for its time-invariant cardinality coefficients (Corollary 12) and explicitly leaves quenched convergence unresolved; the present result proves a special fair frozen case. The paper does not give a variance-three cross-variation fluctuation theorem. The 2022 general characterization specifies a criterion but does not verify the almost-sure frozen-environment bracket limit. A directly related accessible historical claim proves quenched convergence for independently resampled cardinality arrays, which is not a corollary covering coefficients reused permanently over time. Distinct statement and implication comparisons were made; the priority claim remains qualified by possible earlier random-scenery representations.
residual_risks: A previously published general quenched theorem for iid random scenery under monotone renewal sampling might directly imply the specialized convergence; an exhaustive literature survey was not accomplished.

The original paper has distinct totally-unordered and inclusion-induced coefficient models; they can have the same annealed law in fair cases, but equality of annealed laws does not identify typical conditional environments. Priority in a more general representation is not fully excluded.
